user.title: Zaya Planner
user.description: Add the planner of smart home tasks. Tasks are created with the zaya_planner.upsert action and shown on the “Schedule” calendar.

data_description.lateness_hours: A task without its own `expires` is not run if it is later than this (for example after Home Assistant was off).
data_description.action_prefix: Only scripts whose entity id starts with this prefix can be tasks, for example script.plan_
data_description.retention_days: Finished tasks older than this are removed.
data_description.notify_action: Action that sends notifications about failed tasks, for example notify.mobile_app_phone or a script with title and message fields. Empty: a notification in Home Assistant.

error.invalid_prefix: The prefix must start with “script.” and name a group of scripts, for example script.plan_
error.invalid_action: Write an action as domain.action, for example notify.mobile_app_phone

upsert.name: Plan a task
upsert.description: Plans a task: when and what to do. Changes the task with the same ID while its time has not come; a task that is already due is left to the executor. A task of a rule in the past is not created.

id.name: ID
id.description: Key of the task. A second call with the same ID changes the task instead of adding one.

title.name: Title
title.description: For people: shown on the calendar and in the plan.

due.name: At
due.description: Date and time. A time without a time zone is local time.

due_entity.name: At the time of
due_entity.description: Instead of a date: an entity with a time, e.g. Sun “Next sunset” or “Next sunrise”, a date-and-time helper, a timestamp sensor. Its value is taken now, when the task is planned.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Minutes after (+) or before (−) that time.

devices.name: Devices
devices.description: Turn these devices on or off and wait until they confirm.

state.name: State
state.description: on or off, for the devices.

action.name: Script
action.description: Instead of devices: a script with the allowed prefix that answers ok and reason.

params.name: Parameters
params.description: Passed to the script as its data.

expires.name: Expires
expires.description: Do not run after this time. “always”: run however late (for turning things off). Empty: the lateness limit from the settings.

rule_id.name: Rule
rule_id.description: Rule that planned the task, usually the entity id of the automation (this.entity_id in its templates). Tasks of a rule are never planned in the past.

remove.name: Cancel tasks
remove.description: Cancels the unfinished task with this id, or the rule's tasks that are not due yet.

id.name: ID
id.description: Cancel the unfinished task with this id.

rule_id.name: Rule
rule_id.description: Cancel the rule's tasks whose due time has not come.

ensure_state.name: Turn on/off and confirm
ensure_state.description: Turns devices on or off and waits until each one reports the new state. Answers ok and reason, so a task can use it directly as its action.

not_loaded.message: Zaya Planner is not set up.

action_not_allowed.message: Action {action} is not allowed: a task runs zaya_planner.ensure_state or a script starting with {prefix}.

expires_before_due.message: “expires” is earlier than “due”: the task could never run.

state_required.message: Choose the state (on or off) for the devices.
